blind.description: A stylized red and gold dragon figurine resting in a crouched, seated pose atop an ornate faceted pedestal. The dragon features small golden horns, a golden segmented underbelly, folded wings, and a thick tail curled around its flank. The base is an octagonal beveled plinth with gold trim and an embedded red gem at the front. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly modeled in a polished, stylized game-asset aesthetic with painted highlights and shadows.
blind.from_above: From directly above, the dragon's head points forward/downward flanked by two symmetrical folded wings, with its crested spine running down the center and its thick, scaly tail curled around the upper-right corner of the base.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: ornate faceted octagonal pedestal with gold trim and a red gem
blind.height_vs_figure: about one-third the height of the figure (around 1.5 to 1.8 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 feet wide
